1.consolidated_definition: Dícese de la persona que está en prisión por no poder prestar fianza por causa que se le imputa, pero aún no ha sido convicta.
1.en_consolidated_definition: This is referred to as a person who is in prison due to being unable to post bail because of the charges against them, but who has not yet been convicted.
